inclusionPolicy.rawSource: Raw-source counts measure committed source files as written, including frontmatter and markdown markup for lesson/template files.
inclusionPolicy.narration: Narration-ready counts include title, summary, lesson body text with markdown/URLs stripped, module overview teaching text, and visual explainer text where that explainer adds new teaching copy. They exclude credits panels, source-library entries, navigation labels, timers, and repeated chrome.
